1_requirements.notes: Interactive interview with the user (11 areas, incl. 10-platform-and-deployment: target engine & portability, dbt, Terraform/IaC, CI/CD), then write <workspace>/requirements/*.md

2_architecture.notes: Reads phase 1 output, writes <workspace>/design/*.md incl. mermaid diagrams, transformation-design.md (dbt) and deployment-and-iac.md (Terraform + CI/CD)

3_build_and_test.notes: Reads phase 2 design, writes <workspace>/build/*.md (build plan + per-component buildsheets + fixtures catalog + local-dev guide) and scaffolds the starter repo under <workspace>/build/repo/: stubs for every component EXCEPT a runnable walking-skeleton slice (demo/, DEMO.md - one source end to end on DuckDB: load -> DQ quarantine -> reconciliation gate -> publish). Then the stub bodies are implemented against the buildsheets before a real pipeline run.

4_pipeline_and_git.notes: Reads phases 2-3, writes <workspace>/pipeline/*.md (repo layout, orchestration wiring, Terraform IaC plan, CI/CD plan, git workflow, environments & config) and scaffolds infra/ + orchestrator + .github/workflows/ skeletons. /validate-config checks the wiring.

5_full_testing_and_hardening.notes: Reads phases 2-4, writes <workspace>/hardening/*.md (test strategy, DQ behaviour matrix, reconciliation fixtures, CI gates, observability wiring, security review, runbook, go-live checklist incl. backfill + rollback drills).
